items.title: Plain cartouche
items.note: A plain label with clipped corners and a small rosette on the lower rule, like the map title boxes.

items.title: Tablet with handles (tabula ansata)
items.note: A label plaque with dovetail handles. The form is commonest in Roman times; use it as a generic plaque, not as a period piece for 400 BC.
items.use: One or two lines of text in x 76 to 284.

items.title: Compass rose
items.note: A sixteen-point compass rose for maps. Letters left off so it reads in any language; north is up.

items.title: Corner: bracket
items.note: A plain double-rule corner with a stud: the catalogue look.

items.title: Corner: meander
items.note: A meander corner for the top-left; mirror it for the others.
items.use: Mirror with transform="scale(-1 1)" or (1 -1).

items.title: Corner: palmette
items.note: A palmette growing out of the corner, for the top-left.
items.use: Mirror for the other corners.

items.title: Corner: tesserae
items.note: A tesserae corner with a red keystone.

items.title: Divider: three dots
items.note: Three dots in a row: the quietest section break.

items.title: Divider: ivy
items.note: A waving ivy rule, for feasts and wine.

items.title: Divider: laurel
items.note: Two laurel branches meeting at a rosette: for a victory or an honour.

items.title: Divider: short meander
items.note: A short running meander rule.

items.title: Divider: sword on a hair
items.note: A rule with the sword of Damocles hanging from its middle: a section break for a moment of danger.

items.title: Divider: tesserae
items.note: A single line of tesserae, as at the top and foot of the season cards.

items.title: Divider: wave
items.note: A rule of rolling waves, for news from the sea.

items.title: Fleuron: ivy leaf
items.note: The ivy leaf (hedera), the oldest printers' and stonecutters' fleuron; the game uses the ❦ character for it.

items.title: Fleuron: three dots
items.note: Three stacked dots, the word divider of Greek inscriptions.

items.title: Fleuron: lotus
items.note: A lotus bud, the eastern flower that Greeks and Phoenicians both used.

items.title: Fleuron: palmette
items.note: A single palmette.

items.title: Fleuron: rosette
items.note: An eight-petal rosette.

items.title: Fleuron: sword on a hair
items.note: The game's emblem as a small mark: a sword hanging by a hair (Cicero, Tusculan Disputations 5.61-62).

items.title: Catalogue card frame
items.note: A card with a title band and a meander rule under it, for a ledger entry, a person's file or a museum label.
items.use: Put the title in the band (y 20 to 58) and the text below the meander (y 84 on).

items.title: Drop-cap box
items.note: A square for an initial letter, in the blood red of the game's drop caps (ui/styles/art.css .dropcap).
items.use: Set the letter in the 64-unit square in the middle.

items.title: Inscription block
items.note: A limestone block under a dentil cornice, with an incised border: for a decree, a law, a treaty or the title of a public notice.
items.use: Cut-in capitals (IM Fell English SC, letter-spaced) in x 40 to 440, y 56 to 128, colour #4a4030.

items.title: Meander frame
items.note: A panel framed on all four sides by a running meander.

items.title: Papyrus roll, open
items.note: An open papyrus roll between its two rolled ends: for a quotation from a historian, a decree or a chronicle page.
items.use: Text in x 60 to 460, y 30 to 170.

items.title: Greek grave stele
items.note: An Attic-style grave stele with a pediment and palmette acroteria. For a death, an epitaph or a memorial notice.
items.use: Text or a figure in the panel x 36 to 204, y 124 to 372.

items.title: Punic votive stele
items.note: A pointed Punic stele with the sign of Tanit in the gable, the shape of the votive stones from the tophets of Carthage and Motya (general knowledge, not a copy of one stone). For Carthaginian news and treaties.
items.use: Text in the panel x 50 to 190, y 132 to 370.

items.title: Tesserae frame
items.note: A border of tesserae in the game's four-colour order, for the big moments the art direction gives to mosaic.

items.title: Empty tondo
items.note: The event picture frame with nothing in it: glaze, meander ring and ground line. Draw a new scene inside.
items.use: Draw figures in the 120-unit box above the ground line (y 90.5), inside r 46.

items.title: Wax tablet, open
items.note: A wooden diptych with dark wax, scratched lines and a bronze stylus: letters, denunciations, secret orders. The lines are blank scratches, not writing.
items.use: Put text over the wax panels (x 24 to 218 and x 262 to 456, y 26 to 274) in a light colour.

items.title: Victor's ribbon
items.note: A red victor's fillet (taenia) as a banner: for a win at the games or a public honour.
items.use: One line of text, x 60 to 420, in the page colour.

items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/patterns/tesserae-band-glaze.svg) repeat-x 0 0 / 28px 8px;

items.title: Tesserae band
items.note: The tesserae band of ui/styles/art.css, drawn as a tile.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/patterns/tesserae-band.svg) repeat-x 0 0 / 28px 8px;

items.title: Tesserae field
items.note: A floor of square tesserae in the game's colours. Repeats both ways.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/patterns/tesserae-field.svg) repeat 0 0 / 48px 48px;

items.title: Tongues, bronze
items.note: Rounded tongues hanging from a rail, as on vase shoulders. Colourway: bronze on a transparent ground, for parchment pages.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/patterns/tongues-bronze.svg) repeat-x 0 0 / 10px 12px;

items.title: Tongues, glaze
items.note: Rounded tongues hanging from a rail, as on vase shoulders. Colourway: clay on black glaze, to sit with the red-figure pictures.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/patterns/tongues-glaze.svg) repeat-x 0 0 / 10px 12px;

items.title: Running wave, bronze
items.note: The rolling wave (running dog) of Greek borders; good under sea pictures and maps. Colourway: bronze on a transparent ground, for parchment pages.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/patterns/wave-bronze.svg) repeat-x 0 0 / 20px 14px;

items.title: Running wave, glaze
items.note: The rolling wave (running dog) of Greek borders; good under sea pictures and maps. Colourway: clay on black glaze, to sit with the red-figure pictures.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/patterns/wave-glaze.svg) repeat-x 0 0 / 20px 14px;

items.title: Zigzag, bronze
items.note: A plain zigzag between rails, as on Geometric pots. Colourway: bronze on a transparent ground, for parchment pages.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/patterns/zigzag-bronze.svg) repeat-x 0 0 / 12px 10px;

items.title: Zigzag, glaze
items.note: A plain zigzag between rails, as on Geometric pots. Colourway: clay on black glaze, to sit with the red-figure pictures.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/patterns/zigzag-glaze.svg) repeat-x 0 0 / 12px 10px;

items.title: Bronze with verdigris
items.note: Old bronze (#7a5424) going green in patches with verdigris (#28603f), for armour, statues and plaques. Seamless 256 x 256 tile.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/textures/bronze.png) repeat;

items.title: Black glaze
items.note: The black glaze of the event pictures (#1d1410) with a faint sheen; a dark ground for clay-coloured drawing. Seamless 256 x 256 tile.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/textures/glaze.png) repeat;

items.title: Limestone
items.note: Warm, pitted limestone like the walls of Epipolae and the quarries. Seamless 256 x 256 tile.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/textures/limestone.png) repeat;

items.title: Marble
items.note: White marble with grey veins, for temples, statues and inscriptions. Seamless 256 x 256 tile.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/textures/marble.png) repeat;

items.title: Papyrus
items.note: Crossed layers of papyrus strips: long fibres one way, then the other. Seamless 256 x 256 tile.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/textures/papyrus.png) repeat;

items.title: Parchment
items.note: The game's page colour (#efe4c8) with soft mottling and faint fibres; a background for panels and cards. Seamless 256 x 256 tile.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/textures/parchment.png) repeat;

items.title: Sea wash
items.note: The maps' pale sea (#dfe5d8) with a soft wash, for map backgrounds and harbour panels. Seamless 256 x 256 tile.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/textures/sea-wash.png) repeat;

items.title: Terracotta
items.note: Fired clay in the figures' colour (#c8743a), with grit and a little uneven firing. Seamless 256 x 256 tile.
items.use: CSS: background: url(assets/library/made/textures/terracotta.png) repeat;
